- From the line, \(\displaystyle \lim_{x\to -1^-}f(x)=3\).
- From the curve, \(\displaystyle \lim_{x\to -1^+}f(x)=-3\), and \(f(-1)=-3\).

Since \(3\neq -3\), the function has a jump discontinuity at \(x=-1\).
